citations.quote: The CHAMPION PHOENIX trial was intended to test whether faster platelet inhibition with cangrelor at the time of PCI would reduce the rate of periprocedural thrombotic events compared to a drug with a slower antiplatelet effect, clopidogrel, given at about the time of PCI.

phase.text: Large randomized, double-blind superiority outcome trial

citations.quote: All three were large, randomized, double-blind superiority trials in which patients who had undergone coronary angiography were randomized immediately before PCI to cangrelor followed by a

design.text: Randomized, double-blind study; patients randomized 1:1 to KENGREAL (n=5472) or to clopidogrel 300 or 600 mg (n=5470)

citations.quote: It was a randomized, double-blind study in which patients with coronary artery disease (stable angina, UA/NSTEMI, STEMI) requiring PCI and receiving standard therapy including aspirin and heparin or bivalirudin were randomized 1:1 to KENGREAL (n=5472) or to clopidogrel 300 or 600 mg (n=5470).

population.text: Patients with coronary artery disease (stable angina, UA/NSTEMI, STEMI) requiring PCI who had not taken an oral P2Y12 inhibitor and were not receiving glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitors

citations.quote: Patients who had already taken an oral P2Y_{12} platelet inhibitor were not eligible to enroll. Patients administered glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitors (GPI) or for whom GPI use was planned were also not eligible to enroll.

endpoint.text: First occurrence of the composite of all-cause mortality, MI, ischemia-driven revascularization (IDR), and stent thrombosis (ST) within 48 hours after randomization

citations.quote: The primary outcome measure was the first occurrence of any one of the composite endpoint of all-cause mortality, myocardial infarction (MI), ischemia-driven revascularization (IDR), and stent thrombosis (ST) within 48 hours after randomization.

result.text: Primary composite endpoint: 257 (4.7%) KENGREAL vs 322 (5.9%) clopidogrel; OR 0.78 (95% CI 0.66, 0.93); p=0.005 (relative risk reduction 22%)

citations.quote: KENGREAL significantly reduced the occurrence of primary composite endpoint events compared to clopidogrel (relative risk reduction [RRR] 22%).

indication.text: Indicated as an adjunct to PCI to reduce the risk of periprocedural MI, repeat coronary revascularization, and stent thrombosis in patients who have not been treated with a P2Y12 platelet inhibitor and are not being given a glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitor

citations.quote: KENGREAL is indicated as an adjunct to percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) to reduce the risk of periprocedural myocardial infarction (MI), repeat coronary revascularization, and stent thrombosis (ST) in patients who have not been treated with a P2Y12 platelet inhibitor and are not being given a glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitor [see *Clinical Studies* (14.1)].

target_moa.text: Direct-acting P2Y12 platelet receptor inhibitor that blocks ADP-induced platelet activation and aggregation

citations.quote: KENGREAL is a direct-acting P2Y12 platelet receptor inhibitor that blocks adenosine diphosphate (ADP)-induced platelet activation and aggregation. The chemical structure is similar to adenosine triphosphate (ATP).
